methods.label: Identifying the guaranteed outcome
methods.explanation: The bag contains only red balls, so any ball drawn must be red. This is a certain event. A and B are random events, and D is an impossible event.
methods.levelReason: The method uses only the Grade 9 distinctions among certain, random, and impossible events.
